instruction: Tidy up my desk: pens stand upright in the magenta pen holder, the mug goes on the blue coaster, notebooks go on the orange tray, and crumpled paper balls go into the red wastebasket. Some things are already where they belong; leave them there.

attempts.code:
# Grasp yellow_pen and place it upright into magenta_holder
obs = observe()
candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
# Choose a clear grasp across the pen's short side
best = min(candidates, key=lambda c: abs(c["squeeze_width"] - 0.012) if c.get("hand_clear", True) else 999)
res = grasp(best)

if res["holding_something"]:
    holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
    hx, hy, hz = holder["center"]
    rim_h = holder.get("rim_height", 0.08)

    # Move above the holder safely above its rim
    carry_to(hx, hy, height=rim_h + 0.12)

    # To place a pen upright in a cup/holder, lower it into the cup opening and release
    # Lower pen into the holder opening
    move_by(dz=-(rim_h + 0.05))
    open_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.15)
    go_home()
    check("yellow_pen", "magenta_holder")

# The pen is currently resting across magenta_holder horizontally.
# Observe scene, grasp the pen, reorient it vertically, lower into holder, and release.
obs = observe()
pen = obs["objects"]["yellow_pen"]
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy, hz = holder["center"]
rim_h = holder.get("rim_height", 0.08)
table_z = obs["table_z"]

# Grasp the pen
candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
cand = min(candidates, key=lambda c: abs(c["squeeze_width"] - 0.012) if c.get("hand_clear", True) else 999)
res = grasp(cand)

if res["holding_something"]:
    # The pen's long axis lies along the gripper's side vector (side = approach x finger_axis).
    # To orient the pen vertically, the gripper's side vector needs to point along [0, 0, -1] or [0, 0, 1].
    # Pitch the gripper so approach is horizontal: e.g. approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0],
    # then side = approach x finger_axis = [0, 0, 1] (vertical!).
    # First lift safely above the holder
    carry_to(hx, hy, height=rim_h + 0.15)
    
    # Orient the gripper to make the pen vertical
    target_z = table_z + rim_h + 0.08
    move_gripper(hx, hy, target_z, approach=[1.0, 0.0, 0.0], finger_axis=[0.0, 1.0, 0.0], path="line")
    
    # Lower pen into the holder
    move_by(dz=-0.05)
    open_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.15)

go_home()
check("yellow_pen", "magenta_holder")

# Observe and get yellow_pen grasp candidates
obs = observe()
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy, hz = holder["center"]
rim_h = holder.get("rim_height", 0.08)
table_z = obs["table_z"]

candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
# Pick a candidate across short side with appropriate height or adjust height
cand = next((c for c in candidates if c.get("squeeze_width", 0) < 0.03), candidates[0]).copy()
# Ensure grasp height goes deep enough to grasp the pen (pen center z is at 0.846 -> height ~0.046 above table)
cand["height"] = 0.046
res = grasp(cand)

if not res["holding_something"]:
    # Fallback: try candidate 0 directly
    cand = candidates[0]
    res = grasp(cand)

if res["holding_something"]:
    # Carry pen safely above holder
    carry_to(hx, hy, height=rim_h + 0.18)
    
    # Orient gripper horizontally so the pen (along side vector) becomes vertical
    # approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0] gives side = [0, 0, 1]
    target_z = table_z + rim_h + 0.08
    move_gripper(hx, hy, target_z, approach=[1.0, 0.0, 0.0], finger_axis=[0.0, 1.0, 0.0], path="line")
    
    # Lower pen into the holder
    move_by(dz=-0.04)
    open_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.15)

go_home()
check("yellow_pen", "magenta_holder")
